day_shape: 73 items: IRGC claims strike on LPG tanker near Hormuz and vows action beyond strait, CENTCOM says 133 vessels redirected under blockade, UK and UN Security Council meet on Yemen, London court hears Iran-spying case, regime channels push Qalibaf/Rezaei responses to Rubio.

threads.label: Hormuz enforcement and US blockade
threads.summary: The IRGC navy said it struck a 'violating' LPG tanker and warned action against unauthorised vessels would extend beyond the Strait of Hormuz, in its 18th statement. CENTCOM said US forces had redirected 133 commercial vessels as of 9 October enforcing the blockade on Iran, while Vitol warned a disruption to ship-to-ship transfers could push oil to $200.

threads.label: Tehran rhetorical volley at Rubio
threads.summary: Speaker Qalibaf and SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei issued historical-rhetoric responses to US Secretary of State Marco Rubio's remarks on Iranian civilisation, invoking Alexander and the Roman emperor Valerian's defeat by Shapur I. IRIB and Defa Press amplified the exchange across multiple posts.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Gaza and on Syria border
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Syrian operative Yusuf Ali Al-Hassoun on the Syria-Lebanon border, saying he acted under Iranian direction, and reported killing three Hamas and Islamic Jihad operatives and dismantling four weapons stores in Gaza. Troops also said they struck a figure who crossed the Yellow Line in northern Gaza.

threads.label: Pezeshkian at CIS and Caspian summits
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian attended the Commonwealth of Independent States summit, held a trilateral with Putin and Aliyev on Caspian cooperation, and met Turkmenistan's Berdimuhamedov. Foreign Minister Araghchi said the Russia-initiated trilateral agreed economic projects among the three states.

threads.label: UK Iran-spying prosecutions in London
threads.summary: A London court heard that two men accused of spying for Iran conducted surveillance on the Israeli Embassy, Britain's oldest synagogue, Iran International's offices and presenter Kambiz Hosseini. Both pleaded not guilty, and OpenAI separately reported an Iran-origin influence operation placed nearly 100 articles and targeted Iran International.

threads.label: Yemen at UN Security Council
threads.summary: The UN Security Council's 10236th meeting on Yemen heard from Special Envoy Hans Grundberg and Assistant Secretary-General Mohamed Yahya. UK Deputy Permanent Representative Kate Foster delivered a statement condemning what she called a dangerous Houthi escalation, and the US Embassy in Jordan issued a travel advisory citing the Houthi attack on Riyadh airport.

threads.label: Rights, executions and southeast Iran violence
threads.summary: HRANA reported Iran executed at least 2,003 people in the past year, a 29% rise, and Iran International reported a 17-year-old died in Isfahan custody after a Basij beating. Haalvsh reported at least five security personnel killed in four attacks in the southeast within 24 hours, and Defa Press reported the martyrdom of a Sistan-Baluchestan police deputy in Zahedan.
